```{r}
bd_model_env_stats_sub = bd_model_env_stats %>%
  select(taxon_capture,

         regions,
```

## Define analysis functions
```{r}
#| eval: true
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show processing & visualization functions"

get_species_name = function(taxon, newline = FALSE) {
  species_name = str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", gsub("usgs", "", taxon)))
  if (newline) {
    species_name = gsub(" ", "\n", species_name)
  }
  return(species_name)
}

wilson_ci = function(p_hat, n, conf.level = 0.95) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - conf.level) / 2)
  
  denominator <- 1 + (z^2 / n)
  centre_adjusted_probability <- p_hat + (z^2 / (2 * n))
  adjusted_standard_deviation <- sqrt((p_hat * (1 - p_hat) / n) + (z^2 / (4 * n^2)))
  
  lower_bound <- (centre_adjusted_probability - z * adjusted_standard_deviation) / denominator
  upper_bound <- (centre_adjusted_probability + z * adjusted_standard_deviation) / denominator
  
  return(c(lower_bound = lower_bound, upper_bound = upper_bound))
}

wilson_ci_lower = function(p_hat, n, conf.level = 0.95) {
  ws = wilson_ci(p_hat, n, conf.level)
  return(ws[1])
}

wilson_ci_upper = function(p_hat, n, conf.level = 0.95) {
  ws = wilson_ci(p_hat, n, conf.level)
  return(ws[2])
}

mmode = function(x) {
  ux = unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

# posterior summary with median and equal-tailed (quantile) intervals.
# pd: probability of direction. support: "strong" if 0 is outside the 95% interval
# (pd > 0.975), "weak" if 0 is outside the 50% but inside the 95% interval
# (0.75 < pd <= 0.975), otherwise "none". net_effect = 2 * P(> 0) - 1.
f_draw_agg <- function(draws, group_vars, agg_var) {

  draws |>
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) |>
    reframe(
      "{agg_var}_lower_50" := tidybayes::median_qi(.data[[agg_var]], .width = 0.50)[, 2],
      "{agg_var}_upper_50" := tidybayes::median_qi(.data[[agg_var]], .width = 0.50)[, 3],
      "{agg_var}_lower_95" := tidybayes::median_qi(.data[[agg_var]], .width = 0.95)[, 2],
      "{agg_var}_upper_95" := tidybayes::median_qi(.data[[agg_var]], .width = 0.95)[, 3],
      "{agg_var}_median"   := median(.data[[agg_var]]),
      "{agg_var}_net_effect" := (sum(.data[[agg_var]] > 0) / n()) * 2 - 1,
      "{agg_var}_pd" := max(mean(.data[[agg_var]] > 0), mean(.data[[agg_var]] < 0))
    ) |>
    mutate("{agg_var}_support" := case_when(
      .data[[paste0(agg_var, "_lower_95")]] > 0 | .data[[paste0(agg_var, "_upper_95")]] < 0 ~ "strong",
      .data[[paste0(agg_var, "_lower_50")]] > 0 | .data[[paste0(agg_var, "_upper_50")]] < 0 ~ "weak",
      .default = "none"))
}

```

# Results

## Organize draws

### Linpred Draws
```{r}

# define linpred data
nd_env_subadult = model_select$data %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) %>%
  summarize(precip_mm_10_z = median(precip_mm_10_z),
            temp_c_30_z = median(temp_c_30_z),
            kg_code_3 = mmode(kg_code_3),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(life_stage_simple == "subadult")

nd_spp_lss = model_select$data |>
  distinct(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) %>%
  left_join(nd_env_subadult %>%
              select(-life_stage_simple), by = "taxon_capture")

# include taxon-specific env slopes (fixed + r_taxon_capture) so each species' linpred
# at its median env uses its own slopes, not the population-average slopes (as in 05).
# contrasts are unaffected (slopes do not vary by life stage).
re_spp_env = ~ (0 + precip_mm_10_z + temp_c_30_z + I(temp_c_30_z^2) | taxon_capture)

# hu contrast
hu_spp_lss_draws = model_select |>
  linpred_draws(
    newdata    = nd_spp_lss,
    dpar       = "hu",
    re_formula = re_spp_env
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

hu_spp_lss_contrast_draws = hu_spp_lss_draws |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(taxon_capture, .draw),
    names_from  = life_stage_simple,
    values_from = hu
  ) |>
  mutate(hu_contrast = subadult - adult,
         contrast = "subadult - adult")

# mu 
mu_spp_lss_draws = model_select |>
  linpred_draws(
    newdata    = nd_spp_lss,
    dpar       = "mu",
    re_formula = re_spp_env
  ) %>% ungroup()

# species-level mu, diagnostic only: average life stages on the link scale within each draw
mu_spp_draws = mu_spp_lss_draws |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, .draw) |>
  summarise(mu = mean(mu), .groups = "drop")

mu_spp_lss_contrast_draws = mu_spp_lss_draws |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(taxon_capture, .draw),
    names_from  = life_stage_simple,
    values_from = mu
  ) |>
  mutate(mu_contrast = subadult - adult,
         contrast = "subadult - adult")

# mu contrast is only estimable where both life stages have Bd-positive loads;
# otherwise one life stage's mu comes from the prior and model structure alone
mu_resp = as.character(model_select$formula$formula[[2]])

taxa_mu_contrast = model_select$data |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple) |>
  summarise(n_pos = sum(.data[[mu_resp]] > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(taxon_capture) |>
  filter(n_distinct(life_stage_simple) == 2, all(n_pos > 0)) |>
  distinct(taxon_capture) |>
  pull(taxon_capture)

setdiff(unique(model_select$data$taxon_capture), taxa_mu_contrast)  # mu contrast not estimable

mu_spp_lss_contrast_draws = mu_spp_lss_contrast_draws |>
  filter(taxon_capture %in% taxa_mu_contrast)

mu_spp_agg = f_draw_agg(mu_spp_draws, c("taxon_capture"), "mu")
mu_spp_lss_contrast_agg = f_draw_agg(mu_spp_lss_contrast_draws, c("taxon_capture", "contrast"), "mu_contrast")
hu_spp_lss_contrast_agg = f_draw_agg(hu_spp_lss_contrast_draws, c("taxon_capture", "contrast"), "hu_contrast")

# combine
spp_lss_draws = hu_spp_lss_draws %>%
  select(taxon_capture,
         life_stage_simple,
         .draw,
         hu) %>%
  mutate(prevalence = 1 - plogis(hu)) %>%
  left_join(mu_spp_lss_draws %>%
              select(taxon_capture,
                     life_stage_simple,
                     .draw,
                     mu), by = c("taxon_capture", "life_stage_simple", ".draw"))

write_parquet(spp_lss_draws, here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "unified_03_b_spp_lss_draws.parquet"))

# species without an estimable mu contrast keep their hu contrast, with NA mu contrast
combined_agg = hu_spp_lss_contrast_agg %>%
  left_join(mu_spp_lss_contrast_agg, by = c("contrast", "taxon_capture"))

combined_agg_single = combined_agg %>%
  select(taxon_capture,
         hu_contrast_median,
         hu_contrast_net_effect,
         hu_contrast_support,
         mu_contrast_median,
         mu_contrast_net_effect,
         mu_contrast_support) %>%
  distinct()

```

## Observations and predictions
```{r}

# # epred draws
# newdata_basic = expand_grid(taxon_capture = sort(unique(brms_data$taxon_capture)),
#                             life_stage_simple = c("subadult",
#                                                   "adult")) %>%
#   mutate(precip_mm_30_z = 0,

# # way too big, limit to 50 draws!
# epred_original = epred_draws(model_select,
#                              newdata = brms_data,
#                              re_formula = NA,
#                              ndraws = 200) %>%
#   dplyr::rename(bd_load_density_epred = .epred)

epred_fixed = epred_draws(model_select,
                          newdata = nd_spp_lss,
                          re_formula = NA) %>%
  dplyr::rename(bd_load_density_epred = .epred)

# observation data, using the model response (and its cutoff)
obs_resp = brms_data %>%
  mutate(bd_load_resp = .data[[mu_resp]],
         bd_detected_resp = bd_load_resp > 0)

obs_data = obs_resp %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture,
           life_stage_simple) %>%
   summarise(n = n(),
             n_pos = sum(bd_detected_resp),
             bd_prevalence = sum(bd_detected_resp) / n(),
             bd_prevalence_ci_lower = wilson_ci_lower(bd_prevalence, n(), 0.95),
             bd_prevalence_ci_upper = wilson_ci_upper(bd_prevalence, n(), 0.95),
             min_load_inf = min(bd_load_resp[bd_detected_resp]),
             q_25_load_inf = quantile(bd_load_resp[bd_detected_resp], probs = 0.25),
             q_50_load_inf = quantile(bd_load_resp[bd_detected_resp], probs = 0.50),
             q_75_load_inf = quantile(bd_load_resp[bd_detected_resp], probs = 0.75),
             max_load_inf = max(bd_load_resp[bd_detected_resp]),
             se = sqrt(bd_prevalence*(1-bd_prevalence)/n),
             .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label_offset = recode_values(life_stage_simple,
                                          "adult" ~ 0,
                                          "subadult" ~ 1))


```
## Visualize outputs

### Prevalence
```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 12

# observed
ggplot(obs_data, aes(y = bd_prevalence, x = life_stage_simple, color = life_stage_simple)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = bd_prevalence_ci_lower, ymax = bd_prevalence_ci_upper),
                width = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n), y = 1 - (1 - label_offset) * 0.05),
          position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
          size = 4) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap("taxon_capture") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")

# modeled
ggplot(spp_lss_draws, aes(y = prevalence, x = life_stage_simple, fill = life_stage_simple)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap("taxon_capture") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```

```{r}
# diagnostic only, not for interpretation (loads are not comparable across labs):
# modeled species mu with observed mean log load of positives per source (project),
# to check how distinct species and sources are. observed means include random effects
# and are inflated by the cutoff, so they need not match the modeled mu.
mu_obs_project = brms_data |>
  filter(.data[[mu_resp]] > 0) |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, project) |>
  summarise(mu_obs = mean(log(.data[[mu_resp]])),
            n_pos = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

mu_spp_levels = mu_spp_agg |>
  arrange(mu_median) |>
  pull(taxon_capture) |>
  get_species_name()

p_cascade_mu_linpred = ggplot(mu_spp_agg, aes(x = mu_median, xmin = mu_lower_95, xmax = mu_upper_95, y = factor(get_species_name(taxon_capture), levels = mu_spp_levels))) +
```

# r2
```{r}
get_subset_diagnostics = function(model_select, taxon) {
  print(taxon)
  
  taxon_idx = which(model_select$data$taxon_capture == taxon)
  observed = model_select$data[[mu_resp]][taxon_idx]
  
  # Hurdle component - how well does it predict zero vs nonzero?
  fitted_hu = fitted(model_select, dpar = "hu")[taxon_idx, "Estimate"]
  observed_zero = as.integer(observed == 0)
  
  # Simple correlation between predicted P(zero) and actual zero/nonzero
  hu_cor = cor(fitted_hu, observed_zero)
  
  # Lognormal component - nonzero observations only
  nonzero_idx = observed > 0
  obs_log = log(observed[nonzero_idx])
  fitted_mu = fitted(model_select, dpar = "mu")[taxon_idx, "Estimate"]
  # mu is on log scale for lognormal
  
  ss_res = sum((obs_log - fitted_mu[nonzero_idx])^2)
  ss_tot = sum((obs_log - mean(obs_log))^2)
  r2_lognormal = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
  
  gc()
  
  return(list(
    hu_correlation = hu_cor,
    r2_lognormal = r2_lognormal,
    n = length(observed),
    n_nonzero = sum(nonzero_idx),
    pct_zero = mean(observed == 0)
  ))
}

taxon_list = model_select$data %>%
  distinct(taxon_capture) %>%
  pull(taxon_capture) %>%
  sort()

r2_diagnostics_list = purrr::map(taxon_list, ~get_subset_diagnostics(model_select, .x))

r2_estimate = map_dbl(r2_diagnostics_list, "r2_lognormal")

r2_df = tibble(taxon_capture = taxon_list,
               hu_correlation = map_dbl(r2_diagnostics_list, "hu_correlation"),
               r2_lognormal = map_dbl(r2_diagnostics_list, "r2_lognormal"))
```

```{r}
jp_pruned = read.tree(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "phylo_tree.nwk"))

jp_pruned$tip.label

# phylogenetic signal is estimated in 05 (H2 from the meta-model), not here.
# drop species with NA values (e.g. no estimable mu contrast) and prune the tree to match
named_non_na = function(var_values, species) {
  set_named = setNames(var_values, species)
  return(set_named[!is.na(set_named)])
}

prune_tree = function(tree, set_named) {
  return(drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, names(set_named))))
}

# define color maps
sym_div_cont_map = function(tree, var_values, species, center, p_title, style = "div") {
  set_named = named_non_na(var_values, species)

  sym_lim = max(abs(center - min(set_named)), abs(center - max(set_named)))

  map_1 = contMap(prune_tree(tree, set_named), set_named,
                   lims = c(center - sym_lim, center + sym_lim),
                   title = p_title, fsize = 0.4)
  
  if (style == "div") {
    colors = colorRampPalette(c("#762a83", "white", "#1b7837"))(101)
  } else if (style == "lin") {
    colors = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#1b7837"))(101)
  }
  map_2 = setMap(map_1, colors = colors)
  
  return(map_2)
}
```

# Sex composition check
```{r}
# post hoc check (supplementary) of whether the sex composition of sampled adults could
# change the sign of the subadult - adult difference. subadult sex is mostly unknown, so
# subadults (S) are compared with adult males (M) and adult females (F) from observed data.
# whatever the adult sex ratio, the adult value lies between M and F, so the sign of
# S - adult can change with sex ratio only if S lies between M and F, i.e. if
# (S - M) and (S - F) have opposite signs.
#   raw: pooled over each species' data
#   matched: mean of within population-year differences, using only population-years with
#     subadults, adult males and adult females, which removes most confounding of sex
#     with population and time
#   flag: "robust" (S - M and S - F share a sign), "sex-sensitive" (opposite signs), or
#     "not assessable" (too few adults of known sex / matched population-years)
# prevalence: detection above the model cutoff; load: mean natural log load density of
# positives (as mu). observed values ignore model structure, so raw signs can differ from
# the modeled contrast; the modeled sign is shown for reference.

stopifnot(all(brms_data$sex %in% c("female", "male", "unknown")))  # cleaned in 01

min_n_sex = 10         # minimum adult males and adult females (raw)
min_n_matched = 3      # minimum per group within a population-year (matched)
min_popyr_matched = 3  # minimum matched population-years

sex_data = brms_data |>
  mutate(group = case_when(life_stage_simple == "subadult" ~ "S",
                           sex == "male" ~ "M",
                           sex == "female" ~ "F",
                           .default = "U"),  # adults of unknown sex
         detected = .data[[mu_resp]] > 0,
         log_load = if_else(detected, log(.data[[mu_resp]]), NA_real_))

f_sex_flag = function(d_m, d_f, assessable) {
  case_when(!assessable ~ "not assessable",
            sign(d_m) == sign(d_f) ~ "robust",
            .default = "sex-sensitive")
}

# raw
sex_raw = bind_rows(
  sex_data |>
    group_by(taxon_capture, group) |>
    summarise(n = n(), value = mean(detected),
              lower = wilson_ci_lower(mean(detected), n()),
              upper = wilson_ci_upper(mean(detected), n()),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(response = "prevalence"),
  sex_data |>
    filter(detected) |>
    group_by(taxon_capture, group) |>
    summarise(n = n(), value = mean(log_load),
              lower = value - 1.96 * sd(log_load) / sqrt(n),
              upper = value + 1.96 * sd(log_load) / sqrt(n),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(response = "log_load")) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(taxon_capture, response), names_from = group,
              values_from = c(n, value, lower, upper))

# observed adult value (all adults, including unknown sex)
adult_obs = bind_rows(
  sex_data |>
    filter(group != "S") |>
    group_by(taxon_capture) |>
    summarise(value_A = mean(detected), n_A = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(response = "prevalence"),
  sex_data |>
    filter(group != "S", detected) |>
    group_by(taxon_capture) |>
    summarise(value_A = mean(log_load), n_A = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(response = "log_load"))

# matched: within population-year differences
sex_matched = bind_rows(
  sex_data |>
    filter(group != "U") |>
    group_by(taxon_capture, population, year, group) |>
    summarise(n = n(), value = mean(detected), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(response = "prevalence"),
  sex_data |>
    filter(group != "U", detected) |>
    group_by(taxon_capture, population, year, group) |>
    summarise(n = n(), value = mean(log_load), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(response = "log_load")) |>
  filter(n >= min_n_matched) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(taxon_capture, response, population, year), names_from = group,
              values_from = value) |>
  filter(!is.na(S), !is.na(M), !is.na(F)) |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, response) |>
  summarise(matched_n_popyr = n(),
            matched_S_minus_M = mean(S - M),
            matched_S_minus_F = mean(S - F),
            .groups = "drop")

# modeled contrast signs; prevalence is the inverse of hu
sex_modeled = combined_agg_single |>
  transmute(taxon_capture,
            prevalence = paste0(if_else(hu_contrast_median < 0, "+", "-"), " (", hu_contrast_support, ")"),
            log_load = if_else(is.na(mu_contrast_median), NA_character_,
                               paste0(if_else(mu_contrast_median > 0, "+", "-"), " (", mu_contrast_support, ")"))) |>
  pivot_longer(-taxon_capture, names_to = "response", values_to = "modeled_sign")

sex_check = sex_raw |>
  left_join(adult_obs, by = c("taxon_capture", "response")) |>
  left_join(sex_matched, by = c("taxon_capture", "response")) |>
  left_join(sex_modeled, by = c("taxon_capture", "response")) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("n_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)),
         adult_p_male_known = n_M / (n_M + n_F),
         raw_sign = if_else(value_S > value_A, "+", "-"),
         raw_S_minus_M = value_S - value_M,
         raw_S_minus_F = value_S - value_F,
         raw_flag = f_sex_flag(raw_S_minus_M, raw_S_minus_F,
                               n_S > 0 & n_M >= min_n_sex & n_F >= min_n_sex),
         # secondary: could S fall between M and F within their 95% intervals?
         raw_flag_ci = case_when(raw_flag == "not assessable" ~ "not assessable",
                                 value_S > pmin(lower_M, lower_F) & value_S < pmax(upper_M, upper_F) ~ "sex-sensitive",
                                 .default = "robust"),
         matched_flag = f_sex_flag(matched_S_minus_M, matched_S_minus_F,
                                   replace_na(matched_n_popyr, 0L) >= min_popyr_matched),
         species = get_species_name(taxon_capture)) |>
  select(species, taxon_capture, response,
         n_S, n_M, n_F, n_U, adult_p_male_known,
         value_S, value_M, value_F, value_A, lower_M, upper_M, lower_F, upper_F,
         raw_sign, modeled_sign,
         raw_S_minus_M, raw_S_minus_F, raw_flag, raw_flag_ci,
         matched_n_popyr, matched_S_minus_M, matched_S_minus_F, matched_flag) |>
  arrange(response, factor(raw_flag, levels = c("sex-sensitive", "robust", "not assessable")), species)

sex_check |>
  count(response, raw_flag, matched_flag)

sex_check |>
  filter(raw_flag == "sex-sensitive" | matched_flag == "sex-sensitive") |>
  select(species, response, n_M, n_F, adult_p_male_known, value_S, value_M, value_F,
         raw_sign, modeled_sign, raw_flag, raw_flag_ci, matched_n_popyr, matched_flag)

```

## Climate response
```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12

# each species' modeled response to precipitation and temperature, relative to that species'
# median conditions. the species intercept (which carries lab scale and sensitivity) cancels,
# so curves can be compared across species:
#   mu: change in log load, unaffected by a lab's multiplicative scale
#   hu: change in log odds of detection (sign of hu flipped); the sign is comparable, the
#       magnitude depends on detection sensitivity, and part of it can follow from the load
#       response (higher loads clear the cutoff more often)
# env slopes do not vary by life stage, so life stage cancels (adult used throughout).
# taxon slopes are partially pooled: species sampled over a narrow range shrink toward the
# across-species slope.

apply_scale = function(x_new, sc_obj) {
  (x_new - attr(sc_obj, "scaled:center")) / attr(sc_obj, "scaled:scale")
}

env_sc = list(precip_mm_10_day_sum = scale(brms_data$precip_mm_10_day_sum),
              temp_c_30_day_mean = scale(brms_data$temp_c_30_day_mean))

# check the rescaling reproduces the model covariates
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(apply_scale(brms_data$precip_mm_10_day_sum, env_sc$precip_mm_10_day_sum),
                           brms_data$precip_mm_10_z)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(apply_scale(brms_data$temp_c_30_day_mean, env_sc$temp_c_30_day_mean),
                           brms_data$temp_c_30_z)))

env_labels = c(precip_mm_10_day_sum = "10-day precipitation total [mm]",
               temp_c_30_day_mean = "30-day mean temperature [C]")
dpar_labels = c(hu = "Change in log odds of detection",
                mu = "Change in log(Bd load)")

# curve draws over each species' 2.5-97.5% sampled range, other variable at the species
# median, as change from the species median of env_var (first row, ref = TRUE)
f_env_response = function(env_var, n_pts = 50) {
  other_var = setdiff(names(env_sc), env_var)

  nd = brms_data |>
    group_by(taxon_capture) |>
    reframe("{env_var}" := c(median(.data[[env_var]]),
                             seq(quantile(.data[[env_var]], 0.025),
                                 quantile(.data[[env_var]], 0.975),
                                 length.out = n_pts)),
            ref = c(TRUE, rep(FALSE, n_pts)),
            "{other_var}" := median(.data[[other_var]])) |>
    mutate(life_stage_simple = "adult",
           precip_mm_10_z = apply_scale(precip_mm_10_day_sum, env_sc$precip_mm_10_day_sum),
           temp_c_30_z = apply_scale(temp_c_30_day_mean, env_sc$temp_c_30_day_mean))

  purrr::map(c("hu", "mu"), function(dp) {
    model_select |>
      linpred_draws(newdata = nd, dpar = dp, re_formula = re_spp_env) |>
      ungroup() |>
      select(taxon_capture, all_of(env_var), ref, .draw, value = all_of(dp)) |>
      group_by(taxon_capture, .draw) |>
      mutate(delta = value - value[ref]) |>
      ungroup() |>
      filter(!ref) |>
      mutate(dpar = dp,
             delta = if (dp == "hu") -delta else delta)
  }) |>
    list_rbind()
}

f_env_response_agg = function(env_var) {
  f_env_response(env_var) |>
    group_by(taxon_capture, dpar, .data[[env_var]]) |>
    median_qi(delta, .width = c(0.5, 0.95)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(species = get_species_name(taxon_capture))
}

# sampled conditions per species (distinct site-dates) for rugs
env_samples = brms_data |>
  distinct(taxon_capture, site, date, precip_mm_10_day_sum, temp_c_30_day_mean) |>
  mutate(species = get_species_name(taxon_capture))

plot_env_response = function(agg, env_var, dp) {
  ggplot(agg |> filter(dpar == dp), aes(x = .data[[env_var]], y = delta, ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#555") +
    geom_lineribbon(aes(fill = factor(.width)), linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_rug(data = env_samples, aes(x = .data[[env_var]]), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             sides = "b", alpha = 0.2, length = unit(0.02, "npc")) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", direction = -1, name = "Interval") +
    facet_wrap("species") +
    labs(title = paste(dpar_labels[[dp]], "relative to species median conditions"),
         x = env_labels[[env_var]],
         y = dpar_labels[[dp]]) +
    theme_minimal()
}

agg_precip = f_env_response_agg("precip_mm_10_day_sum")
agg_temp = f_env_response_agg("temp_c_30_day_mean")

p_precip_rel_hu = plot_env_response(agg_precip, "precip_mm_10_day_sum", "hu")
p_precip_rel_mu = plot_env_response(agg_precip, "precip_mm_10_day_sum", "mu")
p_temp_rel_hu = plot_env_response(agg_temp, "temp_c_30_day_mean", "hu")
p_temp_rel_mu = plot_env_response(agg_temp, "temp_c_30_day_mean", "mu")

# local slope at each species' median conditions, per 1 SD of the dataset-wide variable.
# central difference over +/- 0.5 SD, exact for the quadratic temperature term
nd_slope = model_select$data |>
  group_by(taxon_capture) |>
  summarise(precip_mm_10_z = median(precip_mm_10_z),
            temp_c_30_z = median(temp_c_30_z),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  cross_join(tibble(env_var = c("precip_mm_10_z", "temp_c_30_z"))) |>
  cross_join(tibble(step = c(-0.5, 0.5))) |>
  mutate(precip_mm_10_z = precip_mm_10_z + if_else(env_var == "precip_mm_10_z", step, 0),
         temp_c_30_z = temp_c_30_z + if_else(env_var == "temp_c_30_z", step, 0),
         life_stage_simple = "adult")

env_slope_draws = purrr::map(c("hu", "mu"), function(dp) {
  model_select |>
    linpred_draws(newdata = nd_slope, dpar = dp, re_formula = re_spp_env) |>
    ungroup() |>
    select(taxon_capture, env_var, step, .draw, value = all_of(dp)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = step, values_from = value, names_prefix = "step_") |>
    mutate(dpar = dp,
           slope = `step_0.5` - `step_-0.5`)
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(slope = if_else(dpar == "hu", -slope, slope))  # hu reported as log odds of detection

# hu slopes: interpret sign / support (net effect), not magnitude
env_slope_agg = f_draw_agg(env_slope_draws, c("dpar", "env_var", "taxon_capture"), "slope") |>
  mutate(species = get_species_name(taxon_capture),
         env_label = recode(env_var,
                            precip_mm_10_z = paste0("Precipitation (1 SD = ",
                                                    round(attr(env_sc$precip_mm_10_day_sum, "scaled:scale")), " mm)"),
                            temp_c_30_z = paste0("Temperature (1 SD = ",
                                                 round(attr(env_sc$temp_c_30_day_mean, "scaled:scale"), 1), " C)")))

p_env_slopes = ggplot(env_slope_agg, aes(x = slope_median, y = reorder(species, slope_median), color = slope_support)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#555") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = slope_lower_95, xmax = slope_upper_95)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = slope_lower_50, xmax = slope_upper_50), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(strong = "#1b7837", weak = "#7fbf7b", none = "#999")) +
  facet_wrap(vars(dpar_labels[dpar], env_label), scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Species response at median conditions (per 1 SD)",
       x = "Change per 1 SD", y = "Species", color = "Support") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(here("size_bd_unified", "unified_figures", "03_precip_rel_detection.png"), p_precip_rel_hu, width = 12, height = 12)
ggsave(here("size_bd_unified", "unified_figures", "03_precip_rel_mu.png"), p_precip_rel_mu, width = 12, height = 12)
ggsave(here("size_bd_unified", "unified_figures", "03_temp_rel_detection.png"), p_temp_rel_hu, width = 12, height = 12)
ggsave(here("size_bd_unified", "unified_figures", "03_temp_rel_mu.png"), p_temp_rel_mu, width = 12, height = 12)
ggsave(here("size_bd_unified", "unified_figures", "03_env_slopes.png"), p_env_slopes, width = 12, height = 10)

p_precip_rel_mu
p_temp_rel_hu
p_temp_rel_mu
```

## Between-population spread
```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# species-specific SDs of the population:life_stage intercepts (gr(..., by = taxon_capture)).
# an SD of log load is unaffected by a lab's multiplicative scale, so mu spreads can be
# compared across species. hu spreads are on the logit scale, whose magnitude depends on
# detection sensitivity: compare with caution.
# with few populations the SD is mostly prior; mu spreads also need Bd-positive loads in
# those populations.  
min_pop = 3

pop_n = model_select$data |>
  group_by(taxon_capture) |>
  summarise(n_pop = n_distinct(population),
            n_pop_pos = n_distinct(population[.data[[mu_resp]] > 0]),
            .groups = "drop")

pop_sd_draws = as_draws_df(model_select,
                           variable = "^sd_taxon_capture:population:life_stage_simple__",
                           regex = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(-.chain, -.iteration) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("sd_"), names_to = "variable", values_to = "pop_sd") |>
  mutate(dpar = if_else(str_detect(variable, "__hu_"), "hu", "mu"),
         taxon_capture = str_remove(variable, "^.*:taxon_capture")) |>
  select(taxon_capture, dpar, .draw, pop_sd) |>
  left_join(pop_n, by = "taxon_capture") |>
  filter(if_else(dpar == "hu", n_pop, n_pop_pos) >= min_pop)

pop_sd_agg = f_draw_agg(pop_sd_draws, c("dpar", "taxon_capture"), "pop_sd") |>
  select(-pop_sd_net_effect, -pop_sd_pd, -pop_sd_support) |>  # SDs are positive
  left_join(pop_n, by = "taxon_capture") |>
  mutate(species = get_species_name(taxon_capture),
         n_label = if_else(dpar == "hu", n_pop, n_pop_pos))

p_pop_sd = ggplot(pop_sd_agg, aes(x = pop_sd_median, y = reorder(species, pop_sd_median))) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = pop_sd_lower_95, xmax = pop_sd_upper_95)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = pop_sd_lower_50, xmax = pop_sd_upper_50), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(x = pop_sd_upper_95, label = paste0("n = ", n_label)),
            hjust = -0.2, size = 3, color = "#555") +
  facet_wrap(vars(c(hu = "Detection (logit SD)", mu = "log(Bd load) SD")[dpar]), scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.25))) +
  labs(title = "Between-population spread within species",
       x = "SD of population intercepts", y = "Species") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(here("size_bd_unified", "unified_figures", "03_population_sd.png"), p_pop_sd, width = 10, height = 8)
```

## Variance components
```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

# where the model attributes each species' variation in log load (mu), as SDs on the log scale:
#   population: population:life_stage intercepts
#   population-year: population:year deviations, by life stage
#   environment: SD of the species' env term (fixed + taxon slopes) over its Bd-positive
#     observations
#   residual: species-level sigma (at a typical population; population sigma effects excluded)
# compare with the raw decomposition below: where a species' raw between-population spread
# is much larger than its modeled population SD, the model is crediting that variation to
# other terms (e.g. population-year, where populations are sampled over many years).

taxa = sort(unique(model_select$data$taxon_capture))

vc_draws = as_draws_df(model_select,
                       variable = c("^sd_taxon_capture:population:life_stage_simple__Intercept:",
                                    "^sd_taxon_capture:population:year__life_stage_simple",
                                    "^b_(precip_mm_10_z|temp_c_30_z|Itemp_c_30_zE2)$",
                                    "^r_taxon_capture\\[",
                                    "^b_sigma_"),
                       regex = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble()

vc_sd = vc_draws |>
  select(.draw, starts_with("sd_")) |>
  pivot_longer(-.draw, names_to = "variable", values_to = "sd") |>
  mutate(taxon_capture = str_remove(variable, "^.*:taxon_capture"),
         component = case_when(
           str_detect(variable, "population:life_stage_simple__") ~ "population",
           str_detect(variable, "simpleadult") ~ "population-year (adult)",
           str_detect(variable, "simplesubadult") ~ "population-year (subadult)")) |>
  select(.draw, taxon_capture, component, sd)

# combined spread across sampling units: sqrt(population^2 + population-year^2) per draw and
# life stage. the population / population-year split is weakly identified where populations
# are sampled in few years, so compare this (not the population SD alone) across species
vc_combined = vc_sd |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = sd) |>
  transmute(.draw,
            taxon_capture,
            `population + population-year (adult)` = sqrt(population^2 + `population-year (adult)`^2),
            `population + population-year (subadult)` = sqrt(population^2 + `population-year (subadult)`^2)) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("population"), names_to = "component", values_to = "sd")

# sigma ~ 1 + taxon_capture (log link); the reference taxon has no taxon term
vc_sigma = purrr::map(taxa, function(tx) {
  col = paste0("b_sigma_taxon_capture", tx)
  tibble(.draw = vc_draws$.draw,
         taxon_capture = tx,
         component = "residual (sigma)",
         sd = exp(vc_draws$b_sigma_Intercept + if (col %in% names(vc_draws)) vc_draws[[col]] else 0))
}) |>
  list_rbind()

# env term SD per draw: sqrt(b' S b), with S the covariance of (precip, temp, temp^2)
# over the species' Bd-positive observations
env_obs = model_select$data |>
  filter(.data[[mu_resp]] > 0) |>
  select(taxon_capture, precip_mm_10_z, temp_c_30_z)

vc_env = purrr::map(taxa, function(tx) {
  x = env_obs |> filter(taxon_capture == tx)
  if (nrow(x) < 2) return(NULL)
  r = function(term) vc_draws[[paste0("r_taxon_capture[", tx, ",", term, "]")]]
  B = cbind(vc_draws$b_precip_mm_10_z + r("precip_mm_10_z"),
            vc_draws$b_temp_c_30_z + r("temp_c_30_z"),
            vc_draws$b_Itemp_c_30_zE2 + r("Itemp_c_30_zE2"))
  S = cov(cbind(x$precip_mm_10_z, x$temp_c_30_z, x$temp_c_30_z^2))
  tibble(.draw = vc_draws$.draw,
         taxon_capture = tx,
         component = "environment",
         sd = sqrt(rowSums((B %*% S) * B)))
}) |>
  list_rbind()

vc_levels = c("population", "population-year (adult)", "population-year (subadult)",
              "population + population-year (adult)", "population + population-year (subadult)",
              "environment", "residual (sigma)")

vc_agg = bind_rows(vc_sd, vc_combined, vc_sigma, vc_env) |>
  f_draw_agg(c("taxon_capture", "component"), "sd") |>
  select(-sd_net_effect, -sd_pd, -sd_support) |>  # SDs are positive
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = vc_levels),
         species = get_species_name(taxon_capture))

vc_spp_levels = vc_agg |>
  filter(component == "population + population-year (adult)") |>
  arrange(sd_median) |>
  pull(species)

p_vc = ggplot(vc_agg, aes(x = sd_median, y = factor(species, levels = vc_spp_levels))) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = sd_lower_95, xmax = sd_upper_95)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = sd_lower_50, xmax = sd_upper_50), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap("component", nrow = 1, labeller = label_wrap_gen(20)) +
  labs(title = "Variance components of log Bd load (mu) by species",
       x = "SD [log scale]", y = "Species") +
  theme_minimal()

# raw decomposition of observed log load (positives), for comparison. population x life stage
# groups with >= 10 positives; between-population SD corrected for sampling noise;
# between-year SD from population x life stage x year means (>= 5 positives, >= 2 years)
f_raw_vc = function(x) {
  pm = x |>
    group_by(population, life_stage_simple) |>
    filter(n() >= 10) |>
    summarise(m = mean(ll), n = n(), v = var(ll), .groups = "drop")
  pym = x |>
    group_by(population, life_stage_simple, year) |>
    filter(n() >= 5) |>
    summarise(m = mean(ll), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(population, life_stage_simple) |>
    filter(n() >= 2) |>
    summarise(sd_yr = sd(m), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(raw_n_pop_ls = nrow(pm),
         raw_population = sqrt(max(var(pm$m) - mean(pm$v / pm$n), 0)),
         raw_population_year = median(pym$sd_yr),
         raw_within = if (nrow(pm) > 0) sqrt(mean(pm$v)) else NA_real_)
}

raw_vc = brms_data |>
  filter(.data[[mu_resp]] > 0) |>
  mutate(ll = log(.data[[mu_resp]])) |>
  group_by(taxon_capture) |>
  group_modify(~ f_raw_vc(.x)) |>
  ungroup()

vc_compare = vc_agg |>
  select(taxon_capture, component, sd_median) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = sd_median) |>
  left_join(raw_vc, by = "taxon_capture") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 2))) |>
  arrange(desc(raw_n_pop_ls))

vc_compare
vc_compare |> filter(taxon_capture %in% c("rana_muscosa", "rana_sierrae"))

ggsave(here("size_bd_unified", "unified_figures", "03_variance_components.png"), p_vc, width = 18, height = 10)

p_vc

```

```{r}
hu_draws_popyr_spp_lss = model_select |>

    newdata    = nd_popyr,

    allow_new_levels = FALSE
  )

hu_popyr_contrast_draws = hu_draws_popyr_spp_lss |>

    names_from  = life_stage_simple,
    values_from = hu
  ) |>
  mutate(hu_contrast = subadult - adult,
         contrast = "subadult - adult")

hu_popyr_adult_agg = f_draw_agg(hu_popyr_contrast_draws %>%
                                filter(!is.na(adult)) %>%
                                mutate(prevalence_adult = 1 - plogis(adult)) %>%

hu_popyr_subadult_agg = f_draw_agg(hu_popyr_contrast_draws %>%
```

```{r}
         filter(taxon_capture == "rana_muscosa",
                !is.na(hu_adult_median),
                !is.na(hu_subadult_median)) |>
         mutate(contrast = hu_subadult_median - hu_adult_median),
       aes(x = year, y = contrast, group = population, color = population)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Subadult - Adult log-odds (hu)",
       title = "Life-stage contrast over time: rana_muscosa") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(popyr_tax_agg_combined |>
         filter(taxon_capture == "rana_sierrae",
                !is.na(hu_adult_median),
                !is.na(hu_subadult_median)) |>
         mutate(contrast = mu_subadult_median - mu_adult_median),
       aes(x = year, y = contrast, group = population, color = population)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Subadult - Adult log-odds (hu)",
       title = "Life-stage contrast over time: rana_muscosa") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### spp comparison
```{r}

# newdata with environment fixed at zero (z-scored mean = no environmental effect)
nd_popyr_env0 = model_select$data |>
  distinct(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, population, year,
           kg_code_3,
           `taxon_capture:population:life_stage_simple`,
           `taxon_capture:population:year`) |>
  mutate(
    precip_mm_10_z = 0,
    temp_c_30_z    = 0
  )

hu_draws_env0 = model_select |>
  linpred_draws(
    newdata      = nd_popyr_env0,
    dpar         = "hu",
    re_formula   = NULL,
    allow_new_levels = FALSE
  )

mu_draws_env0 = model_select |>
  linpred_draws(
    newdata      = nd_popyr_env0,
    dpar         = "mu",
    re_formula   = NULL,
    allow_new_levels = FALSE
  )

# Step 1: mean contrast per population:year per draw
pop_yr_contrast = contrast_draws_env0 |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, population, year, .draw) |>
  summarise(contrast = mean(contrast, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: mean contrast per population (across years) per draw
pop_contrast = pop_yr_contrast |>
  group_by(taxon_capture, population, .draw) |>
  summarise(pop_mean_contrast = mean(contrast, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: variance decomposition per taxon per draw
variance_decomp_agg = variance_decomp |>
  group_by(taxon_capture) |>
  summarise(
    mean_contrast_med  = median(mean_contrast,   na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_between_med     = median(sd_between_pop,  na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_within_med      = median(sd_within_popyr, na.rm = TRUE),
    # uncertainty
    mean_contrast_lower = quantile(mean_contrast,   0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_contrast_upper = quantile(mean_contrast,   0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_between_lower    = quantile(sd_between_pop,  0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_between_upper    = quantile(sd_between_pop,  0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_within_lower     = quantile(sd_within_popyr, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_within_upper     = quantile(sd_within_popyr, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ratio_between = sd_between_med / abs(mean_contrast_med),
    ratio_within  = sd_within_med  / abs(mean_contrast_med)
  )
```

## map
```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(mapview)
library(htmlwidgets)

pop_agg_contrast = pop_agg_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(hu_contrast_median),
         taxon_capture %in% c("rana_muscosa", "rana_sierrae")) %>%
  mutate(species = get_species_name(taxon_capture))

hu_abs_max = max(abs(pop_agg_contrast$hu_contrast_median))
mu_abs_max = max(abs(pop_agg_contrast$mu_contrast_median))

pal_hu = colorNumeric("RdYlBu", domain = c(-hu_abs_max, hu_abs_max), reverse = TRUE)
hu_map = leaflet(pop_agg_contrast) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude, color = ~pal_hu(-hu_contrast_median),
                   radius = 5, fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   popup = ~paste("Population:", population,"<br>Species:", species,"<br>log(detection odds) contrast:", -hu_contrast_median)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal_hu, 
            values = ~(-hu_contrast_median),
            title = "Median log(Bd detection odds)<br>Contrast (subadult - adult)",
            position = "bottomright")

pal_mu = colorNumeric("RdYlBu", domain =  c(-mu_abs_max, mu_abs_max), reverse = TRUE)
mu_map = leaflet(pop_agg_contrast) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude, color = ~pal_mu(mu_contrast_median),
                   radius = 5, fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   popup = ~paste("Population:", population,"<br>Species:", species, "<br>log(load) contrast:", mu_contrast_median)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal_mu, 
            values = ~mu_contrast_median,
            title = "Median log(Bd load)<br>Contrast (subadult - adult)",
            position = "bottomright")

saveWidget(hu_map, here("size_bd_unified", "unified_figures", "maps", "map_prev_contrast_sn.html"))
saveWidget(mu_map, here("size_bd_unified", "unified_figures", "maps", "map_load_contrast_sn.html"))

mu_map
```
